text: AI is changing the way we work. Automation now handles many repetitive tasks, from sorting emails to managing schedules. This allows employees to focus on more creative and complex work. Productivity tools powered by AI, such as smart calendars and writing assistants, help people finish tasks faster and with fewer mistakes. Rather than replacing humans, AI often works alongside them—a true human-AI collaboration where each side contributes different strengths. However, these changes also affect jobs. Some roles may disappear, while new ones appear, and many existing jobs will require new skills. For workers, the key to success is staying flexible and willing to learn.
